title: 2.5.6 Wrap Only What Can Fail
description: Rewrite a try that wraps too much so the total still prints even when the risky line fails. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for Problem Set 2.5.12 (rewrite a too-wide try)

steps.title: Move the loop outside try
steps.instructions: The starter has a for loop that computes a total, wrapped inside one try block along with a risky console.log(label) line. Move the for loop and the let total = 0; declaration so they run before the try block, not inside it.

steps.title: Keep only the risky line in try
steps.instructions: Inside try, keep only console.log(label) (label is never declared, so this is the risky line) with its catch. Log the total with console.log after the whole try...catch finishes, not inside it.

requirements.title: for loop present
requirements.description: The loop that computes the total is still in the file

requirements.title: total logged after catch
requirements.description: The total is logged after the catch block, not inside the try
